setup_logging_default: run setup_logging to configure transformers_cfg logger at WARNING level by default
setup_logging_debug: run setup_logging with TCFG_LOG_LEVEL set to DEBUG for verbose logging output
setup_logging_env: run setup_logging to read TCFG_LOG_LEVEL env var and set the logger level accordingly
review_setup_logging: review setup_logging to understand how it maps env var values to logging levels
refactor_setup_logging: refactor setup_logging to add a custom formatter or file handler for log output
